where: The Mourning Fields — the fallow farmland north of Coldfog where the Hollowing put the field-kin to sleep under grey blankets
mood: Hush — a farm lullaby slowed to a whisper over fields of sleeping kin; tender, grey, almost home.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
soft pulse-wave lead singing a slow lullaby melody
thin low string pad like evening mist over a field
gentle triangle bass rocking root and fifth
a single glassy bell at the end of each phrase

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a music box turns over once, alone, a soft rocking arpeggio in D minor, the mist pad breathing in underneath}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lullaby melody: a gentle rising lift that reaches a little too high, then settles down toward home and stops just short of it on the fifth; slow, singable, rocking in three}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the lullaby again, the music box now answering each phrase like a sleeper sighing, a faint bell at the end of the line}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: up to B-flat major for a moment, the lead rests and the music box carries a warmer, almost hopeful phrase over the strings, like a memory of harvest, then it greys again toward D minor}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lullaby returns, softer, the lift reaching and the settle hanging on the fifth; the last bar rocks straight back into the theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
